{"seon.dev.mcp/namespace":"scratch.astra.store","seon.dev.mcp/session-id":"default","seon.dev.mcp/cluster":"default","seon.dev.mcp/mode":"jvm","seon.dev.mcp/events":[{"tag":"ret","val":"#:seon.dev.mcp{:value [[{:n 1, :candidate? false, :commits 1, :ms 265.297666, :datoms 19, :storage {:nodes 30, :bytes 2208614}} {:n 1, :candidate? true, :commits 1, :ms 33.309084, :datoms 3, :storage {:nodes 10, :bytes 527736}}] [{:n 10, :candidate? false, :commits 1, :ms 173.15975, :datoms 181, :storage {:nodes 57, :bytes 4769327}} {:n 10, :candidate? true, :commits 1, :ms 40.081625, :datoms 21, :storage {:nodes 10, :bytes 533462}}] [{:n 100, :candidate? false, :commits 1, :ms 299.854917, :datoms 1777, :storage {:nodes 102, :bytes 9038988}} {:n 100, :candidate? true, :commits 1, :ms 56.528416, :datoms 201, :storage {:nodes 10, :bytes 496935}}]], :windowed? false}","ns":"scratch.astra.store","ms":2307}],"seon.dev.mcp/runtime":"clj","seon.dev.mcp/cluster-state":"advertised","seon.dev.mcp/form":"(do
(defn measure-lint [n]
 (let [held (:seon.store/store (#'boot/selected-instance "default"))
       prefix (str "astra-lint-" (id/id))
       mark (fn [database seen]
              (let [nodes (reduce (fn [out a] (into out (idx/-mark (get database a) seen))) #{}
                                  [:eavt :aevt :avet :temporal-eavt :temporal-aevt :temporal-avet])
                    files (filter #(.isFile %) (map #(io/file (:seon.store/dir held) (defaults/key->store-key %)) nodes))]
                {:nodes (count nodes) :bytes (reduce + (map #(.length %) files))}))
       original (subvec lint-rows 0 n)
       results
       (mapv
        (fn [candidate?]
          (let [b (keyword (str prefix "-" candidate?))
                _ (registry/branch! {:seon.store/store held :seon.store/branch b
                                     :seon.cluster.registry/from (get-in (db/committed-value-identity lint-base) [:datahike.value/commit-id])})
                conn (store/open-branch! held b)]
            (try
              (let [identify (if candidate? identify-lint old-lint-identities)
                    seeded (identify original)
                    seed (db/transact! conn (functions/reconcile-tx (db/db conn) seeded (mapv program/row-identity original)))
                    _ (assert (:db-after seed))
                    seen (atom #{}) _ (mark (db/db conn) seen)
                    desired (identify (mapv #(update % :seon.lint/row inc) original))
                    tx (functions/reconcile-tx (db/db conn) desired (mapv program/row-identity seeded))
                    t0 (System/nanoTime)
                    report (db/transact! conn tx)
                    ms (/ (- (System/nanoTime) t0) 1e6)
                    _ (assert (:db-after report))
                    found (functions/published-index-entities (:db-after report) (mapv program/row-identity desired))]
                (assert (= (set desired) (set found)))
                {:n n :candidate? candidate? :commits 1 :ms ms :datoms (count (:tx-data report))
                 :storage (mark (:db-after report) seen)
                 :answer (set (map #(dissoc % :seon.lint/id) found))})
              (finally (store/release-branch! conn)
                       (registry/retire-branch! {:seon.store/store held :seon.store/branch b})))))
        [false true])]
   (assert (apply = (map :answer results)))
   (mapv #(dissoc % :answer) results)))
(mapv measure-lint [1 10 100]))","seon.dev.mcp/root":"/Users/sean/src/seon"}

(defn measure-stamp [n]
 (let [held (:seon.store/store (#'boot/selected-instance "default")) prefix (str "astra-stamp-" (id/id))
       wanted (subvec stamp-rows 0 n) shapes (program/shapes-in (db/carried-projection stamp-base))
       desired (conj (mapv #(assoc % :seon.program/analyzed-source-digest stamp-digest) wanted)
                     (assoc stamp-file-row :seon.fn.file/digest stamp-digest))
       mark (fn [database seen]
              (let [nodes (reduce (fn [out a] (into out (idx/-mark (get database a) seen))) #{}
                                  [:eavt :aevt :avet :temporal-eavt :temporal-aevt :temporal-avet])
                    files (filter #(.isFile %) (map #(io/file (:seon.store/dir held) (defaults/key->store-key %)) nodes))]
                {:nodes (count nodes) :bytes (reduce + (map #(.length %) files))}))
       initial (let [seen (atom #{})] (mark stamp-base seen) @seen)
       outputs
       (mapv (fn [candidate?]
        (let [b (keyword (str prefix "-" candidate?))
              _ (registry/branch! {:seon.store/store held :seon.store/branch b
                                   :seon.cluster.registry/from (:datahike.value/commit-id (db/committed-value-identity stamp-base))})
              conn (store/open-branch! held b)]
         (try
          (let [tx (if candidate? (reconcile-without-stamp shapes (db/db conn) desired [])
                                 (functions/reconcile-tx (db/db conn) desired []))
                t0 (System/nanoTime) report (db/transact! conn tx) ms (/ (- (System/nanoTime) t0) 1e6)
                _ (assert (:db-after report))
                found (functions/published-index-entities (:db-after report) (mapv program/row-identity desired))]
            {:n n :candidate? candidate? :commits 1 :ms ms :datoms (count (:tx-data report))
             :stamp-datoms (count (filter #(= :seon.program/analyzed-source-digest (:a %)) (:tx-data report)))
             :storage (mark (:db-after report) (atom initial))
             :answer (set (map #(dissoc % :seon.program/analyzed-source-digest) found))})
          (finally (store/release-branch! conn)
                   (registry/retire-branch! {:seon.store/store held :seon.store/branch b})))))
        [false true])]
  (assert (apply = (map :answer outputs)))
  (mapv #(dissoc % :answer) outputs)))
(mapv measure-stamp [1 10 100]))","seon.dev.mcp/root":"/Users/sean/src/seon"}
